meta.note: Every phone number, address and opening-hours value below was copied from a published source listed in the entry's "source" field. Nothing was invented. Where a phone or hours could not be verified, the field is null and the UI says so plainly. Hours are daily (same every day) unless "hoursByDay" states otherwise; hoursByDay.fri=null means closed on Fridays. "breaks" lists daily closed intervals (Bangladesh Pharmacy Uttara: 2-4 PM break). Times are Bangladesh time. Phone check: a number is flagged phoneVerified=false when it contains an ascending/descending run of 5+ digits or 5+ identical digits (Care Pharmacy — Banani, +8801612345680, contains 123456). A 4-digit repeat alone does not flag a number: Islamia Habib (+8801763666686, contains 6666) is kept verified because it is published on the chain's own official site. Geocoding 2026-11-26 (OpenStreetMap Nominatim + Google Maps place listings): 21 of the original 41 addresses returned a confident building-level match (name + road/area both match); lat/lng are set only for those — no coordinates were invented and no area-centre point is used as a pharmacy location. New entries (53, added 2026-11-26) were geocoded separately; see their lat/lng. sourceTier is derived from the existing source field: official = the chain's own official site, hospital = a hospital's own site, directory = all other published listings.
